name: Dearest You
source:
One day, you find an unmarked letter in your mailbox. Who could it be from? And what will you do about it?

[From [url=https://high-tea.itch.io/dearest-you]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一天，你在邮箱里发现一封没有署名的信。它会是谁寄来的？你又会如何应对？

[来源：[url=https://high-tea.itch.io/dearest-you]Itch.io[/url]]
